info.title: SolarDoctor API
info.description: Solar anomaly detection and panel localization for drone-captured thermal IR + RGB imagery. Model: ml/thermal/checkpoints/best.pt (GET /health reports its architecture).

get.description: Return plan board state, refreshing any running task statuses.

All parks with their severity trends in ONE call — replaces the
frontend's per-park /park/{id}/trend fan-out on the Overview tab.

schema.title: Response Analytics Overview Api V1 Analytics Overview Get

get.description: List all user correction boxes for an inspect job.

schema.title: Response List Corrections Api V1 Corrections  Job Id  Get

post.description: Persist a user-drawn bounding box correction.

delete.description: Delete a user correction by ID.

get.description:
Compare two inspections of the same park.

Returns three lists keyed by (panel_id, class):
  - new:        present in B, absent in A
  - recurring:  present in both
  - resolved:   present in A, absent in B
List tracked faults for a park, optionally filtered by status.

patch.description:
Update a fault's workflow: status, assignee, due date, priority, notes.

Unknown values → 400; transitions or ownership rules that don't hold → 422.

post.description: Append a comment to a fault's thread.

get.description: List all comments on a fault in chronological order.

schema.title: Response List Fault Comments Api V1 Faults  Fault Id  Comments Get

post.description: Attach a repair proof photo (JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤ 15 MB) to a fault.

schema.title: Response List Fault Photos Api V1 Faults  Fault Id  Photos Get

get.description: Serve a proof photo inline (only types validated at upload are ever served).

post.description: Inspect a single thermal+RGB image pair.
Submit a batch inspection job (runs in background).

get.description: Get the status and progress of an inspection job.
Download the inspection report in the requested format.
List all components with derived assigned/available quantities.

schema.title: Response List Inventory Components Api V1 Inventory Components Get

get.description: List prototypes, each embedding its BOM (assignments + component names).

schema.title: Response List Prototypes Api V1 Inventory Prototypes Get

delete.description: Delete a prototype and its assignments (frees the assigned stock).

post.description: Install qty units of a component into a prototype — bounded by availability.

schema.title: Response List Orders Api V1 Inventory Orders Get

patch.description: Update an order. Transitioning to 'received' on a linked order stocks-in qty.

get.description: Headline numbers for the Inventory tab.

Return combined GPS map data for a batch job.

Aggregates every image's capture position + every anomaly's GPS into a
single payload the frontend can render on Leaflet. When EXIF GPS is
missing, generates deterministic synthetic positions so the map remains
populated.
List saved missions, optionally filtered by park_id. Excludes heavy waypoint payloads.

schema.title: Response List Missions Api V1 Missions Get

get.description: Return one mission including its full waypoint path.

post.description: Upload a georeferenced orthomosaic for a park.

get.description: List all uploaded orthos for a park.
Export the park fault grid as a static PNG image.
Get metadata for a single ortho.

Stream a Web Mercator XYZ tile from a GeoTIFF using rio-tiler.

Centimeter accuracy comes from this endpoint — markers anchored in
WGS84 are rendered on tiles built from the customer's own ortho, so
visual and geometric coordinates stay in lockstep.
Get park summary + inspection history from DB.

patch.description: Assign/unassign a park to a project (and rename).

get.description: Per-panel grid summary for a park's most recent (or specified) inspection.
Per-inspection severity count trend for a park, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Get Park Trend Api V1 Park  Park Id  Trend Get

get.description: Panels with anomalies in at least min_inspections inspections.

schema.title: Response Get Park Recurring Api V1 Park  Park Id  Recurring Get

get.description:
Compare two inspections of the same park, returning a rich per-panel diff.

Query params:
    inspection_a: ID of the baseline inspection
    inspection_b: ID of the comparison inspection

Returns a panel-level diff with status new | resolved | changed | unchanged,
plus full detection lists for both inspections on each affected panel.
List parks from DB — only those the caller may see.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api V1 Projects Get

get.description: Project detail with its sites (parks) and per-site mission/inspection counts.

delete.description: Delete a project; its parks remain but are unassigned.

get.description: Serve an annotated image from a completed job's output directory.

Serve an annotated thermal/RGB image produced by the pipeline.

Strictly bounded:
  - job_id and filename go through regex validation
  - resolved path must stay inside OUTPUT_DIR/job_id
  - filename must end in one of the orchestrator's known suffixes
Return current platform settings.yaml as JSON.

put.description:
Overwrite settings.yaml with the provided dict (top-level key 'settings').

Sync `def` (not `async def`): the body only does blocking file I/O, so
FastAPI runs it in its thread pool instead of stalling the event loop.

get.description: Summary of the thermal→RGB calibration the pipeline will use.

post.description: Validate and store a rig calibration in the database (app_config).

Verify the /track workspace password. Checks the SOLARDOCTOR_TRACK_PASSWORD env
override first, then the hash stored in the Supabase `app_config` table.
The password is never shipped to the frontend bundle.

Set/rotate the /track password (stored hashed in Supabase). Requires the
current password unless none is configured yet (first-time setup).

schema.title: Response List Track Notes Api V1 Track Notes Get
Response List Track Files Api V1 Track Files Get

post.description: Store a reference file (.stl, .pdf, datasheet, …) in the track library.

get.description: Public: tells the console which login UI to render.

post.description: Exchange email + password for an opaque session token.
Revoke the caller's session. Share links and keyless modes have none.

get.description: The caller as the console needs it: role, scope, and account if any.

post.description: Create a link; the plaintext token is in this response and nowhere else.

delete.description: Revoke (idempotent). The row is kept so the audit trail survives.

patch.description: Change role, enable/disable, reset password, or replace project access.

post.description:
Send a test alert through every configured channel.

Always 200: an unconfigured channel reports status "not_configured" and a
delivery failure reports "failed", so the console can show both inline.
Sync `def` so the blocking HTTP/SMTP calls run in the thread pool.

get.description:
Download a park's work orders.

- `format`: csv | xlsx
- `status`: comma-separated statuses (default open,assigned,in_progress)
- `assignee`: case-insensitive exact match
Recent orthomosaic generation jobs for a park, newest first.

post.description: Queue a NodeODM task that stitches images into a GeoTIFF orthomosaic.

delete.description: Cancel a queued or running generation and its NodeODM task.

get.description: Whether the park uses a manual layout (and its summary) or auto-grid.

post.description: Validate and store a manual layout; replaces any existing one.

delete.description: Drop the manual layout so the park falls back to auto-grid.
